name: dishangyijiao-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins distilled from real engineering work. Generic, no project-specific data.

plugins.name: ci-perf
plugins.description: Measure-first CI performance and reliability playbook for self-hosted runners: job/step timing and contention analysis, read-only runner audits, GitHub-hosted-minutes audit, and a repeat-run workflow that keeps full logs to catch intermittent test failures.

plugins.name: source-of-truth
plugins.description: Repository-as-source-of-truth playbook across nine engineering layers: scaffold a new project, review an existing one against the layers (read-only), and fill the gaps one reviewable step at a time.
